sloka: दीर्घकालं प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम् ।अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः ।। ६.६३.५४ ।।
transliteration: dīrghakālaṁ prasuptasya kumbhakarṇasya vikramam ।adya paśyantu bhūtāni bhakṣyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 6.63.54 ।।

translations.english: "I shall kill Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, drink up the ocean the abode of Varuna, crush the mountains totally, and break the earth."
